tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Find public-records sources (datasets, portals, registers, reports) by question or keywords. Use `place` to include everything covering a place, from the city up to federal and global sources. Returns the publisher, how to get the data (API endpoint or page), update rate, last update, licence and wh

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Full details of one source by id: publisher, original link, API endpoint, formats, update rate, last update, licence, location detail, check status and notes.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: The atlas: world, countries, states, counties and cities, with their ids. Filter by parent id (e.g. 'us' for US states) or kind.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: The 15 departments (shelves) every source sits on, with what each covers.

tools.name: list_gaps
tools.description: Records people need that the library doesn't hold yet, or that no agency publishes. Check this before telling a user a record doesn't exist.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: The records SOS.city reads from agencies' open data, one row each: building permits, code-enforcement cases, inspections, certificates of occupancy, new business registrations, grants, weather alerts, earthquakes, US wildfires (NIFC) and SCE power shutoffs. Filter by place, kind, ZIP or street addre

tools.name: request_record
tools.description: Ask SOS.city to find a public record that isn't in the library. It joins the gap board; give an email to hear back. Never for locating or profiling a person.

tools.name: get_store
tools.description: The SOS.city data store: what's free, what costs credits (1 credit = 1 cent), credit packs, city data packs, building records and deep searches, and every way to pay (credits with an API key, x402 USDC, or a Stripe link for a person). Shows the caller's credit balance when an API key is sent.

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Starts a one-time purchase and returns a Stripe Checkout link for the person who pays, plus a status_url to poll. product: credits_1k ($10), credits_10k ($79) or city_pack ($29, needs place). The person must agree to the data-use terms (no screening or profiling people): pass agree_data_use=true onl

tools.name: get_city_pack
tools.description: Every source that covers one place (with publisher, original link, licence and reuse terms) plus a year of records whose sources allow reuse. Costs 2900 credits from the API key's balance. Without credits, use buy (product city_pack) or the REST URL with x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_city_pack · Private data: search_library, list_gaps, search_records, request_record, get_store, get_city_pack · Public sink: request_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_city_pack · Private data: search_library, list_gaps, search_records, request_record, get_store, get_city_pack · Public sink: request_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
